title: 第11章 真不是被什么附了身第12章 吞天诀
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
从前一直好好的，怎么突然就变了？
不知想到了什么，玉皇后面色沉了下来，一定是与那面首有关。
云家长子又如何，不过是个不受宠的废物，绝不能留。
“和离？不可能，除非本宫死。”玉皇后站了起来，死死地盯着沈青鱼。
【我眼瞎了吗？她真是你亲娘？怎么会用这种眼神看你？】
怨恨不甘，还有厌恶。
这真的是一个母亲看女儿的眼神？
“你没瞎，她一直以来都是这样的。”
沈青鱼神色平静，就这么静静地看着玉皇后发疯，直到玉皇后平静下来。
这才淡淡开口：“那你就去死。”
玉皇后：……
下一秒玉皇后气得把身边能砸的东西都拿来砸。
沈青鱼拉着小梨退后几步：“你砸吧，可劲砸！东西没了就没了，毕竟父皇已经无了，没有人会继续惯着你。”
玉皇后刚拿起一个价值连城的玉瓶正要往地上砸，闻言动作僵了僵，但还是把玉瓶给砸了。
“无聊。”沈青鱼看了眼那玉瓶，拉着小梨转身就要走。
“你给本宫站住。”
从前玉皇后发疯，齐恒帝都会想法子去哄，如今齐恒帝‘驾崩’了，就再也没人会真心去宠她哄她了。
极重的失落感，让玉皇后感到无所适从。
沈青鱼脚步微顿了下，还是没有回头，径直往殿外走去。

“来人，给本宫拦下她。”
话音刚落，数名龙卫突然从四面八方出现，下一瞬同等数量的长公主暗卫出现，两两对峙，势均力敌。
气场顿开，平地刮起一阵风。
只要一声令下，就能打起来。
沈青鱼捋了捋被风刮得竖起来的刘海，扭头转身，撸起了袖子。
“不就是打架么？让他们打多没意思，还挺浪费时间的，不如咱母女俩打一架得了。您要真看儿臣不顺眼，干脆直接打死儿臣得了，反正儿臣打不过你。”
说着就抄起了倒在一旁的圆凳子，气汹汹地朝玉皇后走去。
玉皇后瞪大眼睛，整个人都气得直打哆嗦。
“逆女，你个逆女！”
母女打架？寻常人家都丢不起这个脸，何况是一国之母。不管是打赢了，还是打输了，传出去都丢人。
“滚！你给我滚！”
玉皇后气得倒仰，随手抓起东西就往沈青鱼身上砸。
砰！
沈青鱼这下没打算躲，把人气成这个样子，总得让她砸一下消消气，不然真气疯了就不好了。
哪曾想小梨动作那么快，‘咻’一下就挡在她跟前，额头立马给砸了个大包出来。
沈青鱼扶住小梨，顿时也起了火，手上拿着的凳子就这么砸了过去。
不过她武道堪堪黄品，玉皇后已是地品，轻松就被躲过。
可躲是躲了，人却是气懵了。
沈青鱼眼皮跳了下，抱起小梨就跑，不然等玉皇后回过神来，怕要不顾脸面揍她一顿不可。
她前脚刚走，后脚暗卫纷纷跟上。

玉皇后呆呆地站在那里，整个人就跟傻了似的，直到整个宫殿安静下来，她才深吸一口气。
“赤，阳！”
玉皇后整个气炸，真气失控，将周遭一切掀飞。

Everything was fine before, why did it suddenly change?
I don't know what she thought of, but the Jade Queen's face darkened. It must have something to do with that facial hair.
So what if Yun's eldest son is just an unloved waste and must not be kept.
"Harmony? Impossible, unless I die." Queen Jade stood up and stared at Shen Qingyu.
【Am I blind? Is she really your mother? Why am I looking at you like this? 】
Resentment and disgust.
Is this really the way a mother looks at her daughter?
"You're not blind, she's always been like this."
Shen Qingyu looked calm and just watched the Jade Queen go crazy until the Jade Queen calmed down.
Then he said calmly: "Then you go die."
Jade Queen:......
The next second, the Jade Queen was so angry that she smashed everything around her that could be smashed.
Shen Qingyu took Xiaoli back a few steps: "You go ahead and smash it, but hit it hard! Once the thing is gone, it is gone. After all, the father is gone, and no one will continue to pamper you."
The Jade Queen had just picked up a priceless jade bottle and was about to smash it on the ground. She froze when she heard this, but she still smashed the jade bottle.
"Boring." Shen Qingyu glanced at the jade bottle, pulled Xiaoli and turned around to leave.
"Stop for me."
In the past, when the Jade Queen went crazy, Emperor Qi Heng would try to coax her. But now that Emperor Qi Heng has passed away, no one will sincerely pamper her and coax her.
The heavy sense of loss made the Jade Queen feel at a loss.
Shen Qingyu paused slightly, but still didn't look back and walked straight out of the hall.
"Someone, stop her for me."
As soon as he finished speaking, several dragon guards suddenly appeared from all directions, and the next moment an equal number of the eldest princess's secret guards appeared, confronting each other in pairs, evenly matched.
The aura suddenly opened up, and a gust of wind blew from the ground.
Just give the order and the fight can begin.
Shen Qingyu smoothed her bangs that were blown up by the wind, turned around, and rolled up her sleeves.
"Isn't it just a fight? Letting them fight is boring and a waste of time. Why don't we, mother and daughter, have a fight? If you really don't like me, you can just beat me to death. Anyway, I can't beat you."
As he spoke, he picked up the round stool that had fallen aside and walked towards the Jade Queen angrily.
The Jade Queen's eyes widened, and her whole body was shaking with anger.
"Rebellious girl, you rebellious girl!"
Mother and daughter fighting? No ordinary person can afford to lose this face, let alone the mother of a country. No matter whether you win or lose, it will be embarrassing if word spreads.
"Get out! Get out of here!"
The Jade Queen fell back in anger, grabbed something and threw it at Shen Qingyu.
Bang!
Shen Qingyu had no intention of hiding now. She was so angry that she had to give her a blow to calm down, otherwise it would be bad if she went crazy with anger.
Who would have thought that Xiaoli would move so fast, and block her in front of her with a 'whoosh', and a big bump would hit her forehead immediately.
Shen Qingyu held Xiaoli up, and immediately caught fire, and smashed the stool in his hand.
However, her martial arts skills were comparable to those of a high-ranking person, and the Jade Queen was already a high-ranking one, so she was easily dodged.
But he was hiding, but he was confused.
Shen Qingyu's eyelids twitched, he picked up Xiaoli and ran away, otherwise when the Jade Queen came to her senses, she would be beaten regardless of her face.
As soon as she walked away with her front legs, the hidden guards on her back legs followed her.
The Jade Queen stood there blankly, as if she was dumbfounded. She didn't take a deep breath until the entire palace fell silent.
"Chi-yang!"
The Jade Queen was furious, her true energy was out of control, and everything around her was thrown away.
